newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia PWE Industries in Bakun pact.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia PWE Industries in Bakun pact.

text.p: PWE Industries Bhd said on Wednesday that one of its units has received an operation and maintenance contract from Bakun Hydro-Electric Corp Bhd.

In a statement, PWE said Bakun will pay its PWE O&M (Bakun) Sdn Bhd a lump sum of 150 million ringgit annually subject to an adjustment "from time to time" based on fluctuations in costs incurred by PWE O&M for its services.

Under the pact, PWE O&M will provide and manage the facilities associated with the $5.5 billion Bakun project for 30 years. The dam is being built in Sarawak state on Borneo island. Bakun Hydro-Electric is the dam's holding company.

PWE O&M will eventually be a joint venture company comprising PWE, other Malaysian companies and other parties "with relevant expertise and international reputation" in operating, maintaining and managing similar facilities, the statement said.
PWE said it expects to eventually hold 51 percent of PWE O&M.
